propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge on GitHub (read-only mirror) and must be re-landed as three independent Gerrit changes with byte-identical diffs.
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python v6→v7 and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish across 13 workflow files, requiring corresponding updates to the pinned-action allowlist echo lines.

PR #124 upgrades mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0 (major breaking change affecting FastMCP and auth API paths) and ruff 0.15.22→0.16.1; path 1 requires mcp v2 compat validation via full test suite, path 2 defers mcp v2 to a follow-up and lands only ruff bump.
A P0 unblock change (Change 0) must land first to fix click 8.2.1→8.3.3 for pip-audit PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability, unblocking all other CI runs.

Mcp 2.0 breaks imports in mcp_server.py, _mcp_auth.py, and _mcp_models.py (mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP removed); path 2 outcome requires updating _optionality.yml constraint and ADR 0050 only if mcp is upgraded, otherwise both remain unchanged.
After each Gerrit change merges, the corresponding GitHub PR must be closed with a comment linking the Gerrit change URL and noting GitHub is a read-only mirror.
